summary: Computes an adjusted frame offset used for SEH exception-handler dispatch. Given a base value a1 and a descriptor a2 (three dwords), the result is a1 + a2[0]; if a2[1] is non-negative the result additionally accumulates a2[1] plus a dword read through a pointer obtained by dereferencing (a2[1] + a1) and indexing with a2[2].

local_names.a2: descriptor triple (a2[0] primary offset, a2[1] conditional sub-offset/stride, a2[2] secondary index)
local_names.v2: a2[1] cached, sign-checked to select the conditional adjustment
local_names.result: accumulated adjusted offset returned to the caller

operations.description: Load v2 = a2[1], the second dword of the descriptor triple.
Initialize result = a1 + a2[0] using the primary offset in the descriptor.
When v2 (a2[1]) is non-negative, apply the conditional SEH frame adjustment; negative values skip the term.

On the v2 >= 0 path, accumulate result += v2 + *(*(v2 + a1) + a2[2]): dereference the dword at (v2 + a1) to obtain a table pointer, index it with a2[2], and add the value found there together with v2 itself.
